description: This file defines the `ClientSearchData` class, which appears to be a data container for client search results within the Fineract project. It includes fields for client identifiers, status, and related metadata.

classes.name: ClientSearchData
classes.description: A data transfer object capturing client search result information such as identifiers, status, and associated metadata.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the client.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the client.

methods.name: getExternalId
methods.description: Returns the external ID associated with the client.

methods.name: getAccountNumber
methods.description: Returns the account number of the client.

methods.name: getOfficeId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the client's office.

methods.name: getOfficeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the client's office.

methods.name: getMobileNo
methods.description: Returns the mobile number of the client.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the client as an EnumOptionData.

methods.name: getActivationDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the client was activated.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the client record was created.
